```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(knitr)

# Load working papers data
# You'll need to create a 'working_papers' sheet in your cv_data.xlsx file
# with columns: title, authors, abstract, year, status, keywords

# For now, using example data structure
working_papers <- tribble(
  ~title, ~authors, ~abstract, ~year, ~status, ~keywords,
  
  "Machine Learning Applications in Portfolio Construction",
  "John Paul Broussard and Co-Author Name",
  "This paper examines the application of machine learning algorithms to optimize portfolio construction strategies. We utilize deep learning techniques to predict asset returns and construct portfolios that outperform traditional mean-variance optimization. Our findings suggest that neural networks can capture non-linear relationships in financial data that conventional models miss, leading to improved risk-adjusted returns across multiple market conditions.",
  "2025",
  "Under Review",
  "Machine Learning, Portfolio Optimization, Deep Learning",
  
  "The Impact of Algorithmic Trading on Market Microstructure",
  "John Paul Broussard, Second Author, Third Author",
  "We investigate how the proliferation of algorithmic trading has fundamentally altered market microstructure dynamics. Using high-frequency trading data from major exchanges, we document significant changes in liquidity provision, price discovery, and volatility patterns. Our analysis reveals that while algorithmic traders improve market efficiency in normal times, they can exacerbate volatility during stress periods. These findings have important implications for market regulation and design.",
  "2024",
  "Working Paper",
  "Algorithmic Trading, Market Microstructure, High-Frequency Trading",
  
  "Corporate Financial Policy in the Digital Age",
  "John Paul Broussard and Collaborator Name",
  "This study explores how digital transformation affects corporate financial decision-making. We analyze capital structure choices, dividend policy, and investment decisions for firms undergoing significant digital transformation. Using a comprehensive dataset of publicly traded companies, we find that digitalization is associated with lower leverage, higher investment in intangible assets, and a shift away from traditional dividend policies. Our results suggest that digital transformation fundamentally alters the financial landscape for corporations.",
  "2024",
  "In Progress",
  "Corporate Finance, Digital Transformation, Capital Structure",
  
  "Risk Management with Natural Language Processing",
  "John Paul Broussard",
  "We develop a novel approach to risk assessment using natural language processing (NLP) techniques applied to corporate disclosures and news articles. Our methodology extracts risk-related information from textual data and constructs risk measures that predict future volatility and firm distress. The NLP-based risk metrics significantly outperform traditional accounting-based measures and provide early warning signals for financial difficulties. This research bridges the gap between computational linguistics and financial risk management.",
  "2025",
  "Draft",
  "Risk Management, NLP, Text Analysis, Machine Learning"
)

is_pdf <- knitr::is_latex_output()
is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()
```

# Current Working Papers

```{r}
#| label: papers-display-html
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

for (i in 1:nrow(working_papers)) {
  # Status badge styling
  status_class <- case_when(
    working_papers$status[i] == "Under Review" ~ "status-review",
    working_papers$status[i] == "Working Paper" ~ "status-working",
    working_papers$status[i] == "In Progress" ~ "status-progress",
    working_papers$status[i] == "Draft" ~ "status-draft",
    TRUE ~ "status-other"
  )
  
  cat(paste0('
<div class="paper-item">

<div class="paper-header">
<h2 class="paper-title">', working_papers$title[i], '</h2>
<span class="status-badge ', status_class, '">', working_papers$status[i], '</span>
</div>

<div class="paper-meta">
<div class="paper-authors"><i class="fas fa-users"></i> ', working_papers$authors[i], '</div>
<div class="paper-year"><i class="fas fa-calendar"></i> ', working_papers$year[i], '</div>
</div>

<div class="paper-abstract">
<h3>Abstract</h3>
<p>', working_papers$abstract[i], '</p>
</div>

<div class="paper-keywords">
<strong>Keywords:</strong> ', working_papers$keywords[i], '
</div>

</div>

'))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: papers-display-pdf
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

for (i in 1:nrow(working_papers)) {
  cat("\\section*{", working_papers$title[i], "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\textit{", working_papers$authors[i], "} \\\\\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\textbf{", working_papers$year[i], "} • ", working_papers$status[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\subsection*{Abstract}\n\n")
  cat(working_papers$abstract[i], "\n\n")
  cat("\\textbf{Keywords:} ", working_papers$keywords[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\vspace{1em}\n\n")
}
```

## Collaboration Opportunities

I am actively seeking collaborators for research at the intersection of:

- **Machine Learning & AI** in financial markets
- **Market Microstructure** and high-frequency trading
- **Corporate Finance** in the digital age
- **Risk Management** using alternative data sources
- **FinTech** applications and blockchain technology

**Interested in collaboration?** Contact me at [john.broussard@rutgers.edu](mailto:john.broussard@rutgers.edu)
